verdicts.quote: “Requires one of the following OAuth scopes:”
verdicts.reason: The Enterprise API documents OAuth scopes for its RPC/REST methods, indicating OAuth 2.0 bearer-token auth. ([docs.cloud.google.com](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/reference/rpc/google.cloud.notebooklm.v1alpha))

verdicts.quote: “30-day trial then $9 USD per license per month (minimum 15 licenses)”
verdicts.reason: Because Google offers a self‑serve 30‑day trial for Gemini Notebook Enterprise, access is better classified as self_serve_trial rather than paid_plan. ([cloud.google.com](https://cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise/gemini-notebook))

verdicts.quote: “Service for managing notebooks.” … “Service for managing sources.”
verdicts.reason: The reference shows CRUD on notebooks plus source management, sharing, labels, and discovery jobs—core objects but not the full product surface, fitting “moderate.” ([docs.cloud.google.com](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/reference/rpc/google.cloud.notebooklm.v1alpha))

verdicts.quote: “mcp … Run the MCP server (notebooklm-mcp) so an MCP client/agent can drive NotebookLM as tools.”
verdicts.reason: This MCP server is a third‑party project (not by Google), so the status is community. ([github.com](https://github.com/authorityandbrand/notebooklm/blob/main/docs/installation.md))

verdicts.quote: “Preview … subject to the ‘Pre‑GA Offerings Terms’ … The projects.locations.notebooks REST API methods on this page require an authenticated user account with an active Gemini Notebook Enterprise license.”
verdicts.reason: It’s buildable now with documented endpoints and OAuth user tokens, but it’s Pre‑GA and requires Enterprise licenses/IAM—material caveats. ([docs.cloud.google.com](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/notebooklm-enterprise/docs/api-notebooks))
